name: gk-engineering
description: Project-agnostic delivery with bounded autonomous execution windows, evidence-calibrated estimates, declarative safety profiles, audited model routing, fail-closed completion receipts, and Goal retrospectives.

interface.shortDescription: Profile-driven autonomous delivery with fail-closed evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Runs approved work through bounded dependency-ready execution windows that report and continue autonomously; separates cumulative Agent workload from wall-clock critical paths; keeps project-specific targets and safety rules in a declarative Profile; audits runtime provenance; validates immutable completion evidence; and produces an auditable Goal retrospective.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $product-to-delivery to guide this feature from discovery through approved and verified delivery.
